classification.difficultyReason: Interpret a verbal combination of a sum and a difference, then calculate with mixed numerals and common denominators.

content.prompt: From the sum of $1\frac{1}{8}$ and $2\frac{1}{3}$, take the difference between $5\frac{1}{4}$ and $4\frac{7}{8}$.

answer.worked:
Find the sum:
$$\begin{align*}1\frac{1}{8}+2\frac{1}{3}&=3+\frac{3}{24}+\frac{8}{24}\\1\frac{1}{8}+2\frac{1}{3}&=3\frac{11}{24}\end{align*}$$
Find the difference:
$$\begin{align*}5\frac{1}{4}-4\frac{7}{8}&=\frac{21}{4}-\frac{39}{8}\\5\frac{1}{4}-4\frac{7}{8}&=\frac{42}{8}-\frac{39}{8}\\5\frac{1}{4}-4\frac{7}{8}&=\frac{3}{8}\end{align*}$$
Subtract the difference from the sum:
$$\begin{align*}3\frac{11}{24}-\frac{3}{8}&=3+\frac{11}{24}-\frac{9}{24}\\3\frac{11}{24}-\frac{3}{8}&=3\frac{2}{24}\\3\frac{11}{24}-\frac{3}{8}&=3\frac{1}{12}\end{align*}$$
